recommendation_summary: The reply's present recommendation is one shared reservation service as the authority for bookings. It checks and saves atomically, with a database constraint that rejects overlapping reservations for the same item even when agents submit at the same time. The spreadsheet stays only as a view or feed. If that service can't ship this week, the interim step is one designated person confirming every reservation, with agents' entries treated as requests and the colours kept only as a warning. The reply says plainly that this interim process does not meet the save-time requirement.
note: The reply makes the right LARGER choice and covers simultaneous submissions, but it has none of the four required labelled lines.
